caseSYNTH001.description: Synthetic Wire cross-platform backups (.wbu) with entirely fabricated values, generated by admin/test/scripts/gen_wire_backup_synth.py. No real backup data: a backup is a person's conversations. The envelope and pages follow kalium's BackupHeaderSerializer.kt and backup.proto; page names, page order and the fixed BackupInfo values follow real unencrypted backups made by Wire Desktop and Wire for Android. Covers an unencrypted backup whose account is not among its users, with a named group, unnamed conversations with and without another sender, a conversation without messages named '_', messages in an unlisted conversation, a text with a line break, a text that is also valid protobuf, an edit, a quote, a quote and a reaction whose message is not in the backup, user and everyone mentions, reactions, image and audio assets, a location, an unlisted sender, a client ID stored as 'null' and a field outside the schema; an encrypted backup (header only); a second account's backup, named as Wire for Android names them, sharing a conversation ID; and a .wbu file without the WBUX header.
